definitions.full: H6431. Peleth מֶּ֫לֶת proper name, masculine 1. Reubenite Num 16:1 , Φαλεθ[κ] ; read probably מַּלּוּא (q. v.) so Gf Dr and others 2 Judahite 1Chr 2:33 : Θαλεθ, Φαλεθ[ατ] .
